verdict.line: You lose if you let Enrage autos and kill-stacked max HP snowball him past level 6; you win by poking him down with double Lunge before his Q, Cryptic Gaze, is back up.

brief.thesis: Sion has no mana bar and no real disengage once Cryptic Gaze is down — it's a single-target stun on a 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown and his W, Death's Caress, only shields rather than escapes. Fiora's whole trade pattern is to watch that Q cooldown and Sion's stacked max HP from Enrage kills, then punish the window where he has neither stun nor shield up with Lunge resets and Burst of Speed.

theirWindow.when: Q up and he's near brush
theirWindow.what: Don't facecheck or shove blind — OP.GG's own read on this matchup is that Sion threatens hardest with a fully charged Q thrown from inside brush, so hold position and force him to reveal it before you commit minions or your own cooldowns.

yourWindow.when: right after he throws Q to poke or secure CS
yourWindow.what: Go immediately — double Lunge (Q has a free second dash within a couple seconds), then W (Riposte) and E (Burst of Speed) to chain attacks and move speed. He has 8-12s with no stun and no escape.

start.why: Taken in 93.7% of games for a reason — the extra AD rewards every Lunge poke and stacks your Duelist passive heal faster than Sion can out-sustain with raw Enrage autos.

boots.why: Most-picked boot at 55.5%; it specifically blunts Sion's Enrage-boosted autoattacks and Cannibalism-empowered attack speed, which is where most of his damage comes from.

core.why: The top build path (46.9% WR over 32 games) — sustain and cleave let you win extended trades against his Feel No Pain damage reduction.
Adds the burst and move speed to actually punish the window after his Q is down rather than just poking at range.
Converts damage taken from his stacked-HP autoattacks into delayed damage, letting your Duelist passive heal through it.

lane stalls into a long poke war and you need the extra waveclear and sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-winrate page (53.8%) runs Conqueror — its stacking damage and healing on extended fighting matches Fiora's Duelist passive directly and out-sustains Sion's Enrage-fueled autos and Cannibalism leech in a prolonged duel. Master-tier Fiora players instead run Press the Attack across 2,739 games — that suits players who want to end trades fast in the Q-down burst window rather than grind out a long fight.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts the best winrate for this matchup (51.5% over an 18.9% pick rate), letting you reset after poke trades and still make objective fights. Flash+Ignite is far more popular (78.3% pick) but converts to a lower 47.4% winrate here since Sion's Feel No Pain and Enrage sustain blunt the extra kill pressure; Exhaust+Flash shows a strong 66.7% WR but on a tiny 1.7% pick sample, so treat it as a situational pick rather than a default.

playing.title: Poke with double Lunge
playing.detail: Q's free second dash lets you hit, reset, and hit again within a couple seconds — use this whenever his Cryptic Gaze is down to stack your Duelist heal while he has no punish.

playing.title: Hold position near brush
playing.detail: OP.GG flags his fully-charged Q from brush as the real threat in this matchup — don't shove blind into fog when his Q is up, and make him commit it from range first.

playing.title: Trade before his kills stack
playing.detail: Enrage permanently raises his max HP on every unit kill, including minions, so your best trading window is before level 6 while that HP pool is still small.

playing.title: Riposte his empowered autos
playing.detail: W parries his next basic attack and reflects magic damage back — time it for when he's autoattacking aggressively under Enrage, since that's exactly when he's committing to trade through it.

playing.title: Track his Cannibalism cooldown
playing.detail: R is on a 90s cooldown and grants him attack speed plus team-wide leech — avoid extending a fight right after he pops it fresh, and look to all-in once it's down instead.

playing.title: Save R for isolated picks
playing.detail: Blade Waltz deals less damage on successive hits to the same target, so it's a worse tool for grinding through his Enrage/Cannibalism sustain than it is for punishing him when he's caught alone.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, boots, and summoner spell numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — cooldown windows, trade timing, and when to commit — is this brief's own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Sion’s fully charged (Q) used from inside a brush. Contest lane often and pressure him to maintain control over lane.
